first_conception_min_day.prior: Uniform; Calhoun first litters 104 minus gestation ~20

breeding_p_base.prior: Uniform; daily conception probability, cohabiting eligible pair, low density (the only conception channel since phase 2d)

litter_abandon_p.prior: Uniform; daily P(stressed nursing mother abandons her box's litter)

breeding_stress_coef.prior: Uniform; conception suppression per unit stress

menopause_density_threshold.prior: Uniform; dens/capacity where conception is fully suppressed (2200/3840≈0.57)

breakdown_density_threshold.prior: Uniform; dens/capacity above which the social-breakdown stress boost applies (behavioural sink), decoupled from the conception ramp

stress_mortality_scale.prior: LogUniform; stress² mortality — weak: Calhoun adults lived out their lifespans

max_age_days.prior: Uniform; survivors > 987 d at Day 1588; T_max 1000–1143 d (Gwizdałła & Duś)

young_mortality_scale.prior: Uniform; pup/juvenile baseline mortality relative to adult

maternal_neglect_stress.prior: Uniform; stress above which mothers stop nursing / abandon litters

nest_overcrowd_stress.prior: Uniform; extra stress gain in an overfull nest box

social_breakdown_stress_boost.prior: Uniform; extra stress gain when dens > menopause threshold

imprint_rate.prior: LogUniform; competence loss per day per unit exposure while young

imprint_density_threshold.prior: Uniform; local density fraction where developmental exposure begins

withdrawn_competence_threshold.prior: Uniform; adults below this competence withdraw ('beautiful ones')

female_fertile_max_age_days.prior: Uniform; Calhoun: female menopause ≈ 560 d of age

nurse_rate_per_day.prior: Uniform; relaxation rate of a pup's deficit per day in contact with a lactating mother (x her maternal investment); sets pup starvation risk

maternal_erosion_rate.prior: LogUniform; irreversible adult maternal-capacity loss per day per unit stress above threshold (Calhoun C/D: mothers expelled their young); the upper range lets a brief excursion above the threshold do lasting damage

maternal_erosion_stress.prior: Uniform; stress above which adult maternal capacity erodes

breakdown_density_ramp.prior: Uniform; weaned-density width over which the breakdown stress boost ramps up to the threshold (0 = step; Calhoun C: infant mortality rose gradually)

fertility_cap_floor.prior: Uniform; conception probability scales with the female's maternal capacity between this floor and 1 (Calhoun D: pregnancies declined after the peak)

nurse_disturb_coef.prior: LogUniform; nursing effectiveness exp(-coef x local density above onset) (Calhoun C: nursing disturbed under crowding)

nurse_disturb_density.prior: Uniform; local cell density fraction where nursing disturbance starts

courtship_erosion_rate.prior: LogUniform; irreversible male courtship-capacity loss per day per unit stress above threshold (Calhoun D: males ceased courting; last conception ~920)

courtship_erosion_stress.prior: Uniform; stress above which male courtship capacity erodes

stress_density_gain.prior: Uniform; how fast local density raises stress

note: Collapse must emerge from density/social/developmental params; no collapse_day in search space.
